name: io.github.liuqianyu885/mrrbench-pricing
title: MRR Bench Pricing
description: Verified SaaS pricing with the source text and a dated list-price change log.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the MRR Bench index by name or category. Holds 4322 tools with pricing on record (count read from the index).

query.description: Tool name or keyword, at least 2 characters, e.g. 'jennifer' or 'seo'

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: All pricing tiers for one tool, with the verbatim pricing-page evidence behind each price and the date it was checked.

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: Price changes matched on domain, plan name, billing period and billing mode. Each row carries evidence_level: L1 = a person reopened the vendor page and checked both prices by hand; L2 = both dates' snapshots contain the price, machine-checked but not human-confirmed. Rows failing both are hidden unless include_unverified is set. kind="renamed" means a plan name change, not a price change.

since.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to last 90 days

include_unverified.description: Also return rows with no L1/L2 evidence (marked evidence_level=unverified)

tools.name: stack_cost
tools.description: Total cost of a set of tools. Each tool reports its cheapest monthly paid plan; a tool that publishes only an annual price returns that annual total as printed, never a monthly equivalent. Monthly and annual totals are separate fields.
